title: Romantic Getaway to Vietnam & Cambodia
highlights: Weave a love story amidst the enchanting landscapes of Vietnam and Cambodia, from the vibrant cities to the ancient temples.
Immerse yourself in the beauty of Hanoi with a stroll along the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake and a visit to the historic Ngoc Son Temple.
Cruise through Halong Bay, known for its iconic limestone formations rising from emerald-coloured waters.
Witness the remarkable craftsmanship of the Cu Chi Tunnels, a complex network of underground tunnels, living quarters, and hospitals.
Explore the majestic Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, boasting 5 central towers and over 2,000 celestial apsaras carved into its walls.
overview:
About the Tour:
Explore the ancient wonders, rich history, and natural beauty on this honeymoon tour to Vietnam and Cambodia, two of South Asia's most exciting destinations. In Vietnam, you'll discover stunning landscapes with towering cliffs, scenic rivers, and beautiful coastlines, while also exploring areas steeped in war history for a mix of adventure and fun.
Cambodia offers a deep cultural and spiritual journey with its ancient temple ruins, showcasing incredible architecture and timeless grandeur. In addition to visiting UNESCO World Heritage Sites, enjoy a romantic boat cruise on Tonle Sap Lake, where you can experience the peaceful countryside life of Cambodia, creating unforgettable memories.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of bookingg, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

As per Government of India’s rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Sightseeing & Stay
days.desc: Welcome to the capital of Vietnam- Hanoi! Upon reaching Noi Bai International Airport, get transferred to your hotel, check in and relax for a while, marking the start of your romantic trip. Then, get driven to visit the Temple of Literature and Chua Tran, among other attractions. Next, head to Hoan Kiem Lake followed by the Ngoc Son temple and the Huc Bridge. Later, cycle through the Old Quarters of the city with your partner before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, board your pre-booked transfer to explore Ninh Binh with your partner. Visit Hoa Lu, the ancient capital of Vietnam, and the historic temples of the Dinh and Le Dynasties. Then, head to the boat station for a ride to Tam Coc, known as “Halong Bay on Land”. Enjoy a romantic ride on the Ngo Dong River, passing by the limestone formations and rice paddies. Post the boat ride, cycle on scenic villages to Bich Dong Pagoda in Tam Coc. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Stay on Cruise
days.desc: On this day, check out and get transferred to Halong Bay for a romantic trip. Upon arriving at the Tuan Chau Harbour, embark on your cruise journey sailing by the Red Delta Sea and enjoying a Vietnamese lunch onboard. Spend time swimming and kayaking while making a stop at Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village. Also, learn the secrets of cooking Vietnamese dishes with demonstrations onboard. In the evening, savour a delicious dinner onboard and relax under the starry sky with an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your overnight cruise from Tuan Chau Tourist Wharf in Halong Bay and receive a warm welcome with delicious lunch and drinks. 
Take a small boat to explore neighboring islands, relaxing at its coast or taking a swim, before proceeding to visit the Pearl Farm village for an interactive experience. 
Learn about the traditional dishes and flavors during your cooking class on the cruise.

days.title: Visit to Surprise Caves | Transfer to Hanoi
days.desc: Start your day with an exciting Tai Chi martial art lesson on the cruise, followed by an exploration of the Surprise Caves, renowned for its limestone rock formations. Indulge in a delicious Vietnamese meal on board before disembarking and getting transferred to the vibrant city of Hanoi. Check in at the hotel and spend the rest of the day visiting the iconic Thap Rua Tower and witnessing the world of luxury fabrics at Bambou Silk. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Start your day with sunrise, breakfast and a Tai Chi lesson on Sundeck.
Continue exploring Halong Bay by sailing across and visiting some of its major highlights, like the Surprise Caves.
Spend the rest of the time at leisure until you reach back on the coast of Hanoi.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out and get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get driven to the hotel to check in and relax for a while exploring the nearby attractions on your own. Enjoy a bird's eye view of the city from the Bitexco Financial Tower, watch the Golden Dragon Water Puppet Show, or explore the city’s bustling nightlife. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: Today, embark on a city tour by boarding the pre-booked transfer to visit the iconic Reunification Palace. Afterwards, explore the Saigon Central Post Office, a stunning example of French colonial architecture, before delving into the history of the Vietnam War at the War Remnants Museum. Next, journey to the Cu Chi Tunnels, a significant historical site, to witness firsthand the underground network used during the war. Conclude your day by getting driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Mekong Delta
days.desc: On this day, get transferred from the hotel to explore the Mekong Delta on a sightseeing tour with your partner. Spend some time at a popular Buddhist shrine in Vietnam, Ving Trang Pagoda, followed by a visit to the Tortoise Islet. Then, take a boat ride from My Tho along the Mekong River and sail past fish cages and floating houses. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of your hotel and get a transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your flight to Siem Reap, Cambodia. Upon reaching Siem Reap International Airport, get driven to your hotel and check in. After relaxing for a while, embark on a journey to Tonle Sap Lake, Southeast Asia's largest freshwater lake. Board a traditional wooden boat (at an extra cost) for a visit to Chong Kneas Floating Village. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at HARI Residence & Spa - Siem Reap

days.title: Angkor Wat Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Commence your day by getting transferred to Angkor Thom, where an exploration of the magnificent Angkor Wat complex awaits. Begin with the 12th-century Bayon Temple, known for its intricate stone carvings. Post that, head to the Royal Enclosure and visit several other iconic attractions on this day. Conclude your tour with a visit to the Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for its extensive bas-reliefs (decorative sculptures). Later, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.
